## 2026-10-06 02:02 UTC — Move #N.16 shipped-playbook freshness-drift detector

- **What shipped:** A new **Shipped playbook drift** card on the Overview (`/`) Overview page, mounted directly below the existing `RecentlyShippedPlaybooksCard`. For every playbook the operator has marked shipped on `/playbooks#shipped-progress`, the card computes a per-row **drift** = `daysSinceShipped − daysSincePlaybookLastTouched`, classifies it into one of four states (`none` / `mild` / `significant` / `severe`), and surfaces the top-5 most-drifted playbooks as actionable rows with: playbook title, "Re-read" link to `/playbooks#{id}`, shipped-relative-day + days-since, playbook-updated-relative-day + days-since, playbook freshness tier badge (fresh/aging/stale), and a color-coded drift pill (`current` / `Xd drift` / `stale — re-read now` / `no freshness data`). The card headline + border tone scales: emerald when all shipped are current, amber when 1+ are drifting, rose when 1+ are severe (>90d drift). When the operator has 0 shipped, the card renders nothing (no empty-state pollution — the existing `ShippedProgressStrip` already covers that CTA). On hydrate, the card re-reads `ecom-ops:shipped-playbooks:v1` from localStorage and listens for the cross-tab `storage` event + same-tab `ecom-ops:shipped-playbooks:update` CustomEvent so toggling a shipped row on `/playbooks` updates the Overview card within the same browser tick.

- **Why it matters:** Closes the canonical "I shipped Move #1 in March, but the playbook was updated last week — has anything changed that I should re-read before my next iteration?" gap. The shipped tracker already shows shipped count + "X / N shipped" + "last shipped: 3mo ago" + a notes field; the recently-shipped card shows the last 3 with relative days. **But it has zero awareness of whether the playbook itself has been updated since the operator shipped it.** Best practices shift — Klaviyo ships new flow types, Baymard publishes new checkout heuristics, Triple Whale adds new attribution models, Constructor Personalization changes its ranking signal. An operator who hasn't re-read their shipped playbook in 6+ months may be running on stale tactics without knowing it. Move #N.16 is the FIRST shipped-side rollup that compares shipped-date to playbook-mtime and surfaces the gap as a color-coded re-read signal — so the operator knows *which* shipped playbook to revisit, not just *how many* they shipped.

- **Feature class:** cross-page-intelligence (reads `ecom-ops:shipped-playbooks:v1` + the canonical playbook catalog + `lastTouched` from parse-content; writes nothing) + state-persistence-aware (reacts to shipped-map changes via `storage` + CustomEvent; pure read) + interactive-tool (the "Re-read" button is a real link to the playbook; the drift pill is a real color-coded signal).

- **Files added:**
  - `dashboard/src/lib/shipped-freshness-drift.ts` (~280 lines: pure-logic `buildShippedFreshnessDrift(shipped, playbooks, now?, maxRows?)` returns `ShippedDriftSummary { rows, totalShipped, driftedCount, severeCount, maxDriftDays }` where each `ShippedDriftRow` has `id, title, shippedAt, lastTouched, daysSinceShipped, daysSincePlaybookLastTouched, driftDays, driftState, playbookFreshnessTier`; `classifyDrift(driftDays)` → `none | mild | significant | severe | unknown` with thresholds `≤0 / ≤30 / ≤90 / >90`; `describeDriftState(state)` → human label; `driftToneClass(state)` → Tailwind border+bg+text color band; `summaryToneClass(severe, drifted)` → card border tone (rose > amber > emerald); `summaryHeadline(summary)` → "N shipped playbooks >90d behind" / "N drifting" / "All N current" / "No shipped yet"; `relativeDay(iso, now?)` mirrors the existing `RecentlyShipped` helper; internal `daysSince(iso, now)` UTC-midnight-safe with null for unparseable + signed (negative for future-mtime clock skew); rows sorted drift desc (nulls last), then daysSinceShipped desc; unknown playbook ids + invalid shippedAt + future shippedAt are all skipped)
  - `dashboard/src/components/shipped-freshness-drift.tsx` (~290 lines: `<ShippedFreshnessDriftCard playbooks maxRows? />` with hydration-safe stub (`Loading drift…` until `hydrated=true`) + cross-tab `storage` listener (reacts to `ecom-ops:shipped-playbooks:v1`) + same-tab `ecom-ops:shipped-playbooks:update` CustomEvent listener + fresh `buildShippedFreshnessDrift` re-compute on every state change; renders null when 0 shipped; otherwise renders `<Card>` with tone class + headline + per-row pill + freshness tier badge + per-row "Re-read" link to `/playbooks#{id}` + storage-key footer explaining the drift formula)
  - `dashboard/src/lib/__tests__/shipped-freshness-drift.test.ts` (~440 lines, 99 assertions / 24 numbered scenarios covering: classifyDrift null/negative/zero/1/30/31/90/91/365 boundaries, describeDriftState 5 states, driftToneClass 5 tone-class presence checks (emerald/sky/amber/rose/muted), summaryToneClass 4 combinations (rose wins over amber wins over emerald), summaryHeadline 7 cases (no shipped / all current 1 / all current 5 / drifted 1 / drifted 2 / severe 1 / severe 2 with proper singular/plural), buildShippedFreshnessDrift empty / 1-shipped-current / 1-shipped-severe / 1-shipped-unknown-lastTouched / 4-shipped-sort-by-drift-desc / mild-boundary / notes-pass-through / unknown-id-skipped / invalid-shippedAt-skipped / custom-maxRows-1-10-0 / lastTouched-in-future / sort-by-daysSinceShipped-tiebreak / relativeDay today/yesterday/3d/2w/3mo/2y/invalid / freshnessTier compat fresh/aging/stale/unknown — all 99 PASS via `npx jiti`)

## 2026-10-07 15:08 UTC — Move #N.21 shipped: re-read freshness gap

- **What shipped:** A new **Re-read freshness gap** card on the Overview (`/`) directly below the Move #N.20 re-read progress card. For every section the operator has marked re-read, the card compares the mark's `reReadAt` to the playbook's `lastTouched` and surfaces a per-section verdict — `stale since re-read` (rose, when the playbook was updated after the mark, e.g. "+17d since re-read"), `current as of re-read` (emerald, when the mark is still authoritative), or `no lastTouched on playbook` (amber / unknown). The card headline answers the canonical "I re-read this a month ago, has the playbook changed since?" question with a single line: "N of M marked sections stale (playbook updated since re-read) · worst Kd since re-read". Per-row a `stale / current / unknown` badge trio + a `worst +Nd gap` figure + a chain of per-section chips (each chip is a real link to `/playbooks/[slug]#[hash]`). Card border tone scales: rose when any mark is stale, amber when only unknown exists, emerald when every mark is current, neutral when 0 shipped or 0 marks. **Copy freshness log** button emits a paste-ready markdown table with `| Playbook | Stale / marked | Worst gap | Notes |` rows for the operator's standup / Notion / Linear project.

- **Why it matters:** Closes the canonical "I marked this re-read, but is the playbook itself still current?" gap. The Move #N.16/18/20 trio answers WHAT shipped-but-stale / WHERE to re-read / HAVE I marked the recipe. Move #N.21 answers the load-bearing follow-up the trio leaves open: **is the playbook still current as of the moment I marked it re-read?** Without this card, an operator marks a section re-read, walks away for a month, and discovers the playbook has been silently re-written by a sister-cron tick — the mark is technically there, but the underlying material has shifted under it. Move #N.21 surfaces the gap before the operator finds it the hard way. The `gapDays` math is explicit (playbook `lastTouched` − re-read mark) so a +17d gap means "the playbook was updated 17 days after you marked it re-read" — actionable, not vague. The trio is now complete: drift (WHAT) → recipe (WHERE) → re-read (HAVE I) → freshness gap (IS IT STILL ACCURATE).

- **Feature class:** cross-page-intelligence (reads Move #N.18's `DriftFixRecipeSummary` + Move #N.20's `ReReadMap` + the playbook catalog's `lastTouched` parsed at build time; writes nothing; cross-tab `storage` listener for both `ecom-ops:shipped-playbooks:v1` and `ecom-ops:recipe-reread:v1`; same-tab `ecom-ops:shipped-playbooks:update` + `ecom-ops:recipe-reread:update` CustomEvent listeners so marking a section on the re-read progress card re-renders this card on the same tick) + interactive-tool (per-section chip links jump straight to `/playbooks/[slug]#[hash]`; Copy freshness log button emits paste-ready markdown table).
